name: When do I need professional drywall texture matching?

mainEntity.name: When do I need professional drywall texture matching?

acceptedAnswer.text: Professional drywall texture matching is recommended when you have significant damage, such as large holes, water stains, or extensive cracks, that disrupt the original texture. It's also necessary after plumbing or electrical repairs that require cutting into walls. If you are renovating or adding an extension and need new drywall to blend with existing textured walls, a professional can ensure a consistent finish throughout your property. DIY attempts often result in noticeable differences.
acceptedAnswer.description: You need professional drywall texture matching for significant damage, after repairs requiring wall cuts, or when blending new drywall with existing textures.
